title: Jeo Santisima eyes WBC Golden Asia title, seeks to extend family winning streak

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – Former world title challenger Jeo Santisima will vie for the vacant World Boxing Council (WBC) Golden Asia lightweight title against Ukrainian fighter Danylo Honcharuk on Nov. 7, 2026, at The Grand Ho Tram in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. The 30-year-old Santisima is coming off a fourth-round technical knockout (TKO) victory over veteran Alvin Lagumbay in General Santos City, snapping a two-fight losing streak in international bouts. The former ALA boxer previously suffered back-to-back unanimous decision defeats to Mikhail Grigoryan earlier this year and Angelo Peña late last year in Switzerland.
